measurements.start: System.nanoTime before runtime launch/source admission or reference-ready marker, after KMP app ready
measurements.scope: actual common KMP decoder and software-rendered desktop image in owned Xvfb
measurements.coldness: fresh JVM, worker/reference and empty private cache every trial; no metadata/media prewarming
measurements.ordering: serial paired trials with seeded randomized case and engine order; fixed three-pair schedule
measurements.median: successful starts only; success counts retained beside conditional median
measurements.failure_inclusive_median: failed starts treated as infinity, serialized as null when non-finite
measurements.p90: three observations cannot qualify population p90; raw timings and sample maxima retained diagnostically
measurements.resource_sampling: 1Hz owned-process samples; sampled peaks are lower bounds
